marketBrief.headline: Midday, Nov. 13: Tech leads a lower market as October PPI comes in below forecast but yields stay above 5%
marketBrief.summary: At 11:59 a.m. ET the Nasdaq was down about 1.6%, the S&P 500 about 1.1% and the Dow about 0.4% (Investopedia), with Nvidia and chipmakers leading the decline. October producer prices rose 0.3%, below the 0.4% forecast, but the 6.5% annual rate kept a December hike priced in.
bullets: Indexes at 11:59 a.m. ET (Investopedia, intraday): Nasdaq -1.6%, S&P 500 -1.1%, Dow -0.4%. Thursday closes: S&P 500 7,592.40, Nasdaq Composite 25,366.09 (AP).
Chips: AMD down about 11%; Broadcom, Intel, Marvell and Micron each down more than 5%; SOXX down nearly 6% (Investopedia).
Nvidia was down about 4% at midday after Jensen Huang stepped down (Investopedia). MarketWatch showed $159.49 at 10:26 a.m. ET.
October PPI: final demand +0.3% m/m against a 0.4% consensus, +6.5% y/y, the largest annual rise since November 2022 (BLS; CNBC).
Rates: 10-year about 5.14% at 11:59 a.m. ET (Investopedia), above 5.15% after the PPI report (CNBC). CME FedWatch shows 100% odds of a Dec. 9 hike (CNBC).

calendar.why: Came in below the 0.4% consensus (CNBC), but the 6.5% annual rate was the highest since November 2022 (BLS).

calendar.event: October import and export price indexes (BLS)
calendar.why: Next BLS price release after PPI, per the BLS release schedule.
Yahoo Finance says the report comes next Tuesday, while the stock is still reacting to the CEO exit.
Price range $70 to $78 a share (CNBC, Nov. 10). Pricing expected Nov. 18 (Yahoo Finance).

calendar.event: Anthropic shares expected to begin trading
calendar.why: Expected to begin trading Nov. 19 (Yahoo Finance; CNBC). Timing can change.

calendar.event: MSCI removal of Strategy (MSTR) from MSCI indexes takes effect
calendar.why: MSCI said the change takes effect after the close on Nov. 30 (Yahoo Finance). Index funds may sell before then.
FedRateCalc and Tickward list Dec. 8-9. CNBC reports CME FedWatch odds of a hike at 100%, with about 86% for a quarter-point.
BLS schedule lists the November PPI for Dec. 15 at 8:30 a.m. ET.
